faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before you get started.

q1.question: How much does ZekoraPay cost?
q1.answer: Creating an account and basic use are free. Transparent transaction fees apply to certain operations (transfers, exchange), always shown before you confirm.

q2.question: Do I need to create an account?
q2.answer: Yes, an account is required to use ZekoraPay, unlike a simple showcase site — it's a financial platform that moves real money and needs to verify your identity.

q3.question: Which countries does ZekoraPay cover?
q3.answer: ZekoraPay covers several countries in West and Central Africa, with transfer corridors to the diaspora worldwide. Coverage keeps expanding.

q4.question: How are my funds and data protected?
q4.answer: Every sensitive operation (withdrawal, payment, transfer) is protected by your personal PIN, with end-to-end encryption on your data.

q5.question: Can I use ZekoraPay for my business?
q5.answer: Yes. The B2B Enterprise module supports multi-employee management, automated payroll, billing, and even rental management for real-estate businesses.

q6.question: What languages is the app available in?

q7.question: How do I create my first tontine?
q7.answer: From the web app, create your group, invite members by phone or shared link, and set the contribution amount and frequency — ready in minutes.
